claim_boundary: A pinned, independently mirrored-row-validated subset of 273 pool bouts from 13 pools in the 2026 February NAC Junior Men's Foil event. AskFRED independently confirms the event, weapon, category, and published pool grid; USA Fencing confirms the tournament date range. The source contains every bout twice, so PisteFlow reconstructs one bout from the complementary cells and never counts 546 rows as 546 independent bouts. Published names are replaced with pool-scoped pseudonyms. The upstream winner-perspective score fields assume five touches in one V3 bout, and winner-side score margins generally assume five touches allowed; both are corrected from the compact cells and their mirrored counterparts. This one-event observational snapshot cannot establish a causal hot-hand effect or broad athlete generalization.
license: No license file or explicit data license was present at the pinned snapshot; source rows and privacy-minimized derivatives remain local.
